slides.title: DNABERT
text: Early transformer-based DNA language model trained with masked language modeling.
• Pre-trained on the human reference genome (GRCh38, ~3.2 billion bases) using 6-mer tokenization.
Ji et al., DNABERT: pre-trained Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers model for DNA-language in

slides.title: Enformer
text: • Trained on multi-species genome sequences (human + mouse)
with large input windows (~200 kbp = kilo-base pairs)
• Thousands of epigenomic tracks as targets.
Avsec et al., “Effective gene expression prediction from sequence by integrating long-range interactions“, Nature

slides.title: GeneBERT
text: Multi-modal transformer trained with DNA sequence and a 2D matrix of (transcription
• Trained jointly on DNA sequence and chromatin
Mo et al., Multi-modal Self-supervised Pre-training for Regulatory Genome Across Cell Types, ICLR, 2022

slides.title: Pangolin
text: Transformer model predicting RNA splicing and variant-induced
• Trained on multi-tissue splicing data from four tissues (heart, liver, brain, testis)
across four species (human, rhesus macaque, mouse, rat).
Zeng & Li, “Predicting RNA splicing from DNA sequence using Pangolin”, Genome Biology, 2022

slides.title: AlphaMissense
text: DeepMind's AlphaFold-based model for predicting pathogenicity of all possible missense
• A missense variant is a single letter substitution in DNA.
Cheng et al., “Accurate proteome-wide missense variant effect prediction with AlphaMissense”, Science, 2023

slides.title: HyenaDNA
text: Hierarchical convolution-based model capable of modeling
ultra-long DNA sequences (up to 1 million bases) efficiently.
• Previous works used only up to 512 - 4k tokens.
• Pre-trained on the human reference genome.
Nguyen et al., HyenaDNA: Long-Range Genomic Sequence Modeling at Single Nucleotide Resolution, NeurIPS, 2023

slides.title: Evo
text: Evolutionary-scale genomic foundation model trained on millions of prokaryotic genomes,
enabling genome-scale sequence modeling and design.
• Trained on OpenGenome consisting of 2.7M publicly available
Nguyen et al., “Sequence modeling and design from molecular to genome scale with Evo” Science, 2024

slides.title: GROVER
text: Genome-scale foundation model using byte-pair encoding on the entire human genome.
Sanabria et al., “DNA language model GROVER learns sequence context in the human genome”, Nature Machine

slides.title: Nucleotide Transformer
text: Extensive transformer models trained on hybrid dataset of 3,202
Dalla-Torre et al., “Nucleotide Transformer: building and evaluating robust foundation models for human genomics”,

slides.title: GENErator
text: Long-context generative foundation model (1.2B parameters) with a ~98,000-token context
window optimized for synthetic genomic design.
• Eukaryotic DNA corpus (~386 billion bases) covering many higher organisms’ genomes
Wu et al., “GENERator: A Long-Context Generative Genomic Foundation Model”, arXiv, 2024

slides.title: Evo2
text: Extending Evo to 9.3 trillion bases of DNA from >128,000 genomes including bacteria,
archaea, viruses (phages), plants, animals (including human), and more.
• the largest DNA language model with 1M token context dependencies.
Hsu, Hie, et al., “Genome modeling and design across all domains of life with Evo 2”, bioRxiv, 2025

slides.title: RhoFold+
text: Integrated RNA LM-based model for RNA structure prediction.
• Trained with a combination of RNA sequence language modeling and structure learning.
Shen et al., “Accurate RNA 3D structure prediction using a language model-based deep learning approach”, Nature
